name: Creamy Pumpkin-Potato Soup with "Spider Web" Yogurt Drizzle

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice potatoes.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potatoes and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to color, 2-3 minutes.

Add broth, pumpkin, maple syrup, and spices to the pot; stir to combine and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the potato is very soft, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.89 L chicken or vegetable broth
2 (425 g) can pure pumpkin purée
pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place pumpkin seeds in a pile on the baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and maple syrup, then season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp pure maple syrup
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: (7) Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until pumpkin seeds are lightly toasted and fragrant, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool (the seeds will harden as they cool).
When the soup is done, add cream to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Use a hand blender to purée the soup until smooth.
Place additional cream and yogurt in a small bowl; whisk to combine. Transfer the cream mixture to a small ziplock bag.
instructions.secondary_message:
89 ml heavy whipping cream
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Cut a very small hole in one corner of the ziplock bag. Holding onto it like a piping bag, pipe a spiral (spacing the rings about 1/2-inch apart) over the surface of the soup. Using a chopstick, draw lines from the center of the spiral out to the edge (as if you were scoring a pie) to create a spider web design.
Break apart the cooled pumpkin seeds. Sprinkle over soup and enjoy!
